name: Project Zomboid
description: Project Zomboid dedicated server for co-op zombie survival: Build 42 or 41, Steam Workshop mods in one click, a live console and world backups.

notes:
Runs on the [DeployKit Project Zomboid image](https://github.com/deploykithq/deploykit-game-images/tree/master/images/project-zomboid). The first start downloads the dedicated server from Steam (~7 GB) and takes several minutes; later starts only download updates.

- Players join with **host:game-port** and the server password. Publish both UDP ports.
- Log in as **admin** with the admin password to manage the server in game.
- Add mods from the **Mods** tab with a Steam Workshop link. Pick mods made for the build you run: Build 41 mods do not load on Build 42. Workshop items download their latest upload when the server restarts.
- The save is named `servertest`, Project Zomboid's default, so a save from another host can be uploaded as is to `Zomboid/Saves/Multiplayer/servertest` (with `Zomboid/db/servertest.db` for its players). Settings live in `Zomboid/Server/servertest.ini` and `servertest_SandboxVars.lua`. The name, password, player limit, PvP, listing, ports and mod lists in the `.ini` are rewritten from this page on every start; everything else is yours.
- The console takes the server's admin commands: `players`, `servermsg "Hello"`, `save`.
- Switching the build on an existing world is not supported by the game: back it up first.
